title: Screening AI-equipped applicants
abstract: arXiv:2610.34508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI can lower the cost of producing polished application materials without improving applicants' abilities to do the job. We study an employer who observes qualifications and work history, summarized by observable quality, but must infer other job-relevant attributes from reports that applicants can manipulate at costs that depend on privately known manipulation ability. The employer commits to a hiring rule under a capacity constraint, and we evaluate rules by match value net of applicants' manipulation costs. We show that, as manipulation ability becomes increasingly dispersed among applicants with the same observable quality, socially optimal hiring converges to selection on observable quality alone, a phenomenon we call strategic feature collapse. translated_title: 甄别配备AI的求职申请者
translated_abstract: 生成式AI可以降低制作精美申请材料的成本，却不会提升申请者实际胜任工作的能力。我们研究这样一位雇主：他能观察到由“可观测质量”概括的资质与工作经历，但必须从申请者可操纵的报告中推断其他与工作相关的属性，而操纵成本取决于申请者私人所知的操纵能力。雇主在容量约束下承诺一个招聘规则，我们以扣除申请者操纵成本后的匹配价值来评估各规则。我们证明，当可观测质量相同的申请者之间操纵能力日益分散时，社会最优招聘将收敛为仅依据可观测质量进行筛选，我们将这一现象称为“策略性特征坍缩”。为了捕捉报告中剩余的福利收益，我们构建了一个简单的双轨机制，直接录取可观测质量较高的申请者，并向其他部分申请者提供……
tldr: 该论文证明，当申请者借助生成式AI以不同成本美化申请材料、且操纵能力日益分化时，社会最优招聘将退化为仅依据可观测质量进行筛选（即“策略性特征坍缩”），并提出双轨机制以挽回报告信息中剩余的福利收益。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that as AI-enabled manipulation ability becomes more dispersed among otherwise similar applicants, socially optimal hiring collapses to selection on observable quality alone ("strategic feature collapse"), and it designs a simple dual-track mechanism to capture the remaining welfare gains from applicant reports.
